Hi Sanjay / Elena 

Thanks again for a great discovery this morning. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we keep momentum: 

1) Stakeholders we heard on the call:
  - Product / Technical Sponsor: Sanjay Rao (you)  owns PoC success criteria
  - Economic Buyer: Elena Martinez (VP of Ops)  controls budget & final sign-off
  - Security / Compliance: LegalOps team (legalops@nimbushealth.com)  SOC2 / DPA owners
  - Procurement: procurement@nimbushealth.com (TBD contact)

2) Decision criteria you called out:
  - Sub-250ms median latency for live triage workloads
  - Audit logs and token-level cost reporting
  - Dedicated/private deployment option for PHI-sensitive endpoints

3) Legal/contract routing recommendation (what we typically do):
  - NDA first (fastest; enables deep product demos and data sharing)  expect 2–3 business days for review if no commercial redlines
  - MSA next (governs terms; often redlined by both sides)  typical turn time 5–10 business days depending on counters
  - DPA in parallel with MSA when PHI/PII is in scope (usually handled by LegalOps)

4) Items we can provide immediately:
  - Redwood solution brief + SOC 2 summary (attached)
  - Link to our security questionnaire and SOC2 artefacts (Dev included here)

Proposed next steps:
  - Elena / LegalOps: can you confirm the preferred NDA contact and who will be doing MSA redlines?
  - Sanjay: confirm a short follow-up demo next week focused on latency/throughput with your engineering team
  - Marissa/Dev: we'll send the NDA + share SOC2 materials and a short POA for the PoC

Happy to adjust sequencing if your procurement/legal prefers a different flow.

Thanks,
Marissa
